items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: So I played with Ted Heath

ctx.x: After you finished in Cafe Society, where did you go then?

I had been in that one place so long till I went in and out of the city. Glaser booked me. We never could get along but I love Glaser. He's somebody that I always cared for and I think he was very fond of me. I went to him and he booked me on a lot of things. I worked for him for quite a while and then Moe Gale decided that they wanted to break a ban in Europe, a ban of 30 years, so they said the best person to send over there is Mary Lou because the musicians like her.
